<thought>To obtain the precursor combinations, I will search the template catalog for templates that match the target molecule and the described transformation (break a C‑O bond, form a C‑C bond, loss of a ketone and a C≡C). Then I will apply the found template(s) to the target SMILES to get all possible precursor sets.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-O", "C=O", "C#C"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
